name: Henning Diedrich
description: Henning is the protocal lead at Swarm and creator of the open-source, human-readable smart contract language Lexon. He wrote the first book on Ethereum, architected IBM's Hyperledger, and the Diamond Blockchain for DeBeers, and led blockchain research for the European Commission and Temasek. He advised OpenSC, the Wyoming blockchain panel, and runs a live experiment in the future of the firm, a DAO with legal personhood. He gave blockchain talks & keynotes on 5 continents.
